360ONE.s: 360 One Wam ne warrants conversion ke baad Rs 1,174.76 prati share ke bhav par 33,33,333 equity shares allot kiye, jisse company ko Rs 293.69 crore mile.

ZYDUSLIFE.s: Zydus Lifesciences ke Ankleshwar API Unit 2 plant ke liye USFDA se Establishment Inspection Report mili hai.
Zydus Lifesciences ke Ahmedabad SEZ II facility ko USFDA inspection ke baad Voluntary Action Indicated classify kiya gaya hai.

CIPLA.s: Cipla ko asthma ke ilaaj ke liye USFDA se first generic Fluticasone HFA MDI ki approval mili, jiska US market size lagbhag 350 million dollar hai.
